description: Save a durable fact with evidence; several in one call: memories=[{claim,anchors,...}]. anchors: symbol:store.go::Store.Get (a declaration), contains:go.mod::go 1\.23 (regex on the line that proves the claim, not a comment or name), exists:src/auth, file:go.mod (content hash; any edit stales it, avoid on busy files). Anchors must hold now. Absence claims ("no auth"): no anchors, ttl 30d. supersedes: ids of outdated memories to replace. Never store secrets.
name: remember
